issues: Only 2 runs per side; z~1.7 is a weak margin given the stated per-run noise sd of 0.0037, so the ~0.006 gain is not firmly established.

The expanded feature matrix (MACCS + Morgan feature-counts) is passed only to LightGBM; the SVR branch and the std/QuantileTransformer step still use the original Xtr. This appears intentional but is easy to misread as an oversight.

extra_fps() is called twice per fit and rebuilds the Morgan generator on every call; harmless but mildly wasteful. No MolFromSmiles None-check, so a bad SMILES would raise rather than degrade gracefully.
